dpc.name: Direct Plated Copper (DPC)
dpc.positioning: Fine-feature and high-frequency ceramic substrates for semiconductor packaging, RF/microwave, photonics, and precision electronics.
dpc.leadTime: Approximately 2 weeks (depending on design complexity, quantity, material and qualification requirements)
dpc.rfOptimization: RF Design & Performance Optimization up to 40 GHz (performance depends on substrate material, dielectric properties, geometry, circuit layout, metallization, and operating conditions)

dbc.name: Direct Bonded Copper (DBC)
dbc.positioning: High-current, high-power electronics and thermal-management ceramic substrates.
dbc.leadTime: Approximately 2 weeks (depending on design complexity, quantity, material and qualification requirements)
dbc.copperThickness: 127 μm – 500 μm (direct bonded oxygen-containing copper foil)

htcc.name: High-Temperature Co-Fired Ceramic (HTCC)
htcc.positioning: Multilayer ceramic packaging and hermetic electronic enclosures co-fired at 1500°C–1600°C with refractory metals.
htcc.leadTime: Approximately 6–8 weeks (depending on design complexity, layer count, tooling, and qualification requirements)
htcc.metallization: Refractory conductors (Tungsten W / Molybdenum Mo) with post-sinter nickel/gold electroplating
features: Internal signal and ground plane routing
Integrated cavities for die placement and optical components
Brazed seal rings, feedthroughs, and metal leads (Kovar, Cu-W)
High thermal and chemical stability in extreme environments

bareCeramics.name: Bare Ceramic Substrates
bareCeramics.positioning: Partner-sourced technical ceramic raw plates with in-house precision laser cutting, CNC diamond grinding, polishing, and ultrasonic cleaning.
bareCeramics.capacity: Capacity: up to 500,000 bare ceramic substrates per month
materials: Silicon Nitride (Si₃N₄, high fracture toughness and flexural strength)
Silicon Carbide (SiC, extreme hardness and thermal conductivity)
Zirconia (ZrO₂ / Y-TZP, high mechanical strength and wear resistance)
